title: Dead-Letter Path & Backoff
description: Implement the `lib/wdd/mailbox.py` handler for failed workorders. If an agent crashes or the `failure_modes` are hit, the envelope moves to `mailbox/failed/`.

requirements.escalation: Must increment an `attempt_counter` and move to `failed/` if attempts > 3.

acceptance_criteria: A mocked failure moves the envelope to the dead-letter directory.
